basics.name: Zhihao Chen
basics.label: MSc Data Science Student and AI Researcher
basics.summary: First-year MSc student in Data Science at EPFL and Graduate Student Researcher at VILAB. Research interests include representation learning, multimodal foundation models, and continual learning.

work.name: VILAB - EPFL
work.summary: Continuous Generative Modeling for Unified Any-to-Any Multimodal Systems
highlights: Extending unified any-to-any multimodal architectures via continuous generative processes and flow-based decoders across heterogeneous sensory modalities.

work.name: EPFL
work.summary: EE-556 Mathematics of Data: From Theory to Computation

work.name: LAMP - CVC - UAB
highlights: Formulated a sequential benchmark to measure cross-modal catastrophic forgetting between visual reasoning and image synthesis in unified multimodal generative models.
Found that decoupled architectures mitigate bidirectional representation degradation compared with monolithic architectures.
Awarded the Elena Maseras Research Scholarship 2026 for academic excellence (13% acceptance rate).

work.name: IRI - UPC
work.summary: Future Action Prediction in Video Models
highlights: Developed WarmFlow, an encoder-initialized flow-matching framework that replaces pure-noise diffusion with dynamic structural priors for action segmentation.
Achieved competitive generative coherence with one function evaluation (NFE=1), reducing computation by 10x-25x for latency-critical applications.

work.name: BioRob - EPFL
highlights: Extended the SkateFormer architecture for multimodal spatial action recognition, using geometric priors to generalize to occluded layouts.
Curated a 10k-sample dataset and deployed the framework on a ROS2 mobile swarm, achieving a 20% accuracy gain over baselines and 25ms latency for closed-loop control.

work.name: PayRetailers
highlights: Evaluated prompting strategies, including chain-of-thought and few-shot prompting, and connected LLMs to external tools through multi-agent workflows.
Built internal B2B AI solutions, including retrieval-augmented generation systems and automated analytical pipelines.

publications.name: Continual Adaptation Across Modalities: Learning and Forgetting in Unified Multimodal Models
publications.summary: Xinrui Wang, Zhihao Chen, Jia Tang, Alexandra Gomez-Villa, Bartłomiej Twardowski, Joost van de Weijer, and Songcan Chen.

projects.name: B2Travel - HackUPC 2026
projects.summary: Second Prize, Skyscanner Challenge; Best Use of ElevenLabs. Built an LLM-grounded multimodal recommendation system that maps CLIP visual-semantic embeddings into a 3D topological space for spatial retrieval.

projects.name: MXEgg - LauzHack 2025
projects.summary: Overall finalist. Built an LLM-driven multi-agent simulation with a custom physics engine and localized vision to study emergent cooperative behavior.

projects.name: AIvidence - MERIThon 2025 AI Challenge
projects.summary: First Prize. Built a retrieval-grounded multi-agent framework that distributes chain-of-thought reasoning across specialized LLMs for deepfake detection.
